title: Encoding and Decoding Base64 Strings in Python - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Strings are first converted into byte-like objects with .encode(), then encoded using base64.b64encode(). The result can be converted back to a string with .decode().

title: base64 - Base16, Base32, Base64, Base85 Data Encodings - Python documentation
snippet: base64.b64encode(s) encodes a bytes-like object using the standard Base64 alphabet and returns the encoded bytes; b64decode reverses the process.
